أتمايز (form VI)
# أَتَمَايَزُ (ʔatamāyazu) /ʔa.ta.maː.ja.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# أَتَمَايَزَ (ʔatamāyaza) /ʔa.ta.maː.ja.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# أَتَمَايَزْ (ʔatamāyaz) /ʔa.ta.maː.jaz/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
